verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26657853 from Pune Diecast Works to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318727 (dated 2026-09-02). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-010, die-cast statue 'The Getaway' 18 cm, qty 5,600 at 1037 INR, confirmed date 2026-11-17. Incoterms FOB Nhava Sheva, payment NET30. The supplier states it is approved for serial supply (PPAP submitted 2026-09-14). The document has no corrections or handwriting.
observations: Typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The document has no issue date of its own; 2026-09-02 is the date of the customer's order.
The unit price has no per-unit basis stated, and the document gives no line total.
The approval status is the supplier's own statement, not a buyer decision.
